description: This file contains the implementation of a Twig token parser class 'DeprecatedTokenParser', which handles the 'deprecated' tag in Twig templates. The class parses the token stream to create nodes representing deprecated sections in templates.

classes.name: Twig	okenParser\DeprecatedTokenParser
classes.description: Final class implementing a Twig token parser for 'deprecated' tags, responsible for parsing and creating DeprecatedNode instances that mark sections as deprecated within templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'deprecated' tag token and its content to create a DeprecatedNode, handling optional package and version attributes.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'deprecated', which is the tag this parser handles.
